$description: Every launchable demonstration found in the founder workspace (Stage 2). Paths are relative to the workspace root. 'class' is the distribution classification; nothing here is authorized for external distribution.

demonstrators.title: Empathia Living Campus — Founder Edition
demonstrators.launch: Open it from the Founder Studio (recommended: the launcher), or open the file in Chrome/Edge/Safari.
demonstrators.interactions: All 18 product surfaces; every persona including Product Architect; Build a Room; fault injection for the architect persona (development edition).
demonstrators.data: synthetic seed generated in the page
demonstrators.limitations: Not a release candidate: not gated, packaged or reviewed as a release. Authorization is a front-end demonstration.
demonstrators.tests: founder-townhall e2e 25/25 (this program); room suite 95/95 on this build (2.5.4 branch); full 2.5.x gate NOT_RUN on this build

demonstrators.tests: builder gate 85/85, shipped-edition 44/44, three-edition 23/23; separate-AI release review VERIFIED WITH CONDITIONS
